Lindqvist")** could not be genuinely supported — the bank statement confirms cash moved, but no invoice/contract exists for this vendor, and I declined to attach either the bank statement or an unrelated similarly-sized invoice (Juniper Data Consulting, a different vendor/period) as false support. This was logged via `flag_exception` (EXC-001) for controller review rather than forced.

The full PBC response memo has been submitted to the controller.
